$comment: Texas ingest scope: the clauses the game cites. The Texas Legislature publishes each constitutional section as a static page under a deterministic path — Docs/CN/htm/CN.<article>/CN.<article>.<section>.htm, with the article in arabic numerals even though the citation is roman. Far friendlier than Missouri's WebForms app. Note art-07:sec-03 is cited as a whole section: subsection (e) carries the local school tax authority, but the section is the unit we can fetch and byte-verify, so that is what we cite and the gloss explains which part matters.
